description: Get full text of the company's articles of association or statute (umowa spółki / statut) from RAR (Repozytorium Akt Rejestrowych). Use when the user asks about: share transfer consent, preemption rights, non-compete clauses, company duration, voting rights, special share classes, representation rules from the deed, or any clause in the founding document. Returns doc metadata + full extracted text. KRS companies only.

doc_id.description: Optional: specific rar_doc_id. Omit for the latest articles / statute.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

nip.description: NIP — used to resolve KRS when needed.

name: get_company_articles
title: Get Articles of Association
